payload.title: feat/ledger-view at 4df2b9e: replay derives each fact once, render is the one package that gives facts words
payload.body: Replay is the state layer; package render is the channel. Replay derives each fact a view or a ledger refusal tells: an open reading is the owner's answer item in the ledger; status and show read one separates rule; status's assumes lines read the ledger's premises. A ledger refusal (select, reaffirm, add hyp, supersede, abandon) is a replay.Refusal, and render.RefusalText phrases it in the words status prints. render.StopLine is the stop sentence hyp prompt quotes. render.Text: a stored text prints whole on one line. Rule refusals in validate.go keep their text in replay.

why: the build commit of G-NXHHVA, written before its Experiment

payload.title: Gate and review of feat/ledger-view at 4df2b9e
payload.body: Rubric (reading), fixed before the gate runs on 4df2b9e. Aims: G-NXHHVA#1, #2, #3. Gate: (1) new tests: internal/cli/ledger_view_test.go (TestStatusAndShowAgreeOnSeparation, TestStatusAssumesOnlyAPremise, TestRefusalNamesTheItemAsOwedDoes, TestRefusalNamesTheWaitAsStatusDoes, TestStatusPrintsTitleWhole, TestShowPrintsBodyOnOneLine, TestStopSentenceIsWrittenOnce) and internal/replay/facts_test.go (TestOpenReadingIsTheOwnersAnswerItem, TestUnseparatedCandidatesReadsTheRivalRule, TestPremisesLeaveOutAnEdgeInsideTheQuestion). On base 8c6b932 the 7 cli tests are red, each on the behaviour it tests (base-cli.log); the 3 replay tests do not compile there, since they call new API (base-replay.log). Each must be green on 4df2b9e. (2) Removal checks: the commit adds no refusal, so none is owed. (3) go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 green on 4df2b9e. (4) Review: one fresh subagent reviews git show 4df2b9e against the Goal lines and the design, returns each finding as a test file with its output on 4df2b9e, run in a checkout that is not the branch, labelled with the line it is a case of, or none. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on 4df2b9e contradicts H-09292B. (5) Strict check strict-channel, the other reading of line 1 (every text hyp sends the agent, rule refusals and usage errors included, is built in one package): list non-test Go files outside internal/render that build refusal or usage text. It sets no verdict. Verdict: supports when (1) and (3) are green and no line-case review test is red; contradicts when (1) or (3) is red or a line-case review test is red; inconclusive when only cases in doubt fail.

why: the gate of H-09292B, fixed before it runs

payload.observation: Gate on 4df2b9e green: go vet and go test ./... exit 0; the 10 new tests pass (gate-new-tests.log) and were red on base 8c6b932. Each is a case of G-NXHHVA#2 or #3. strict-channel lists 17 files outside internal/render that build refusal or usage text; it sets no verdict.
limits: hyp prompt on an ended Goal and hyp status print the end text, a stored text, in two forms
hyp show prints a reading's answer and its earlier answers in another form than its history lines
hyp render --markdown prints a title, body or observation with a line break raw, so a line of it can read as Markdown structure
hyp add goal echoes a line text with a line break raw, so part of it reads as another line of the output
